body:
1st of all, I'd like to dedicate this report to my friends Josh and Chris. I consider myself an experienced user, I have tried cannabis, alcohol, LSD, psilocybin, salvia, cocaine, DXM, MDMA, nitrous, dimenhydrinate, morning glory, and many other substances. However, nothing I have ever done before has ever been as unique as the experience I recently had. I was at my house with my friends CR and CS when I felt a slight urge to do MDMA. So CS called someone he works with and said he could get us Versatchi pills. We drove to a Mcdonalds where we met up with our supplier and obtained 3 pills. CS could not stay over that not so we gave him his pill and drove him home. When CR and I got back to my house, I called my friend Josh in Ca. to tell him about what we had acquired. He did some quick research and told me that the pills contained both MDMA and MDE.
When I got off the phone with him, we each took our pill orally at 10:45 pm. In around half an hour I was coming up and 10 minutes after that, I was rolling hard. CR didn't feel much of a comeup but 5 minutes after I was rolling, he began to roll also. We were both sitting on my bed talking and rubbing vicks vapor rub on ourselves 'very fun while on MDMA'. CR is a bit homophobic and was telling me not to look at him while he was using the vapor rub. I assured him though that I wasn't gay 'not that I have anything against gay people' and that I wasn't going to do anything to him. He finally relaxed and his homophobic fears left him. We still kept sitting and just talking and having fun with the rub until we started to feel the MDMA wearing off.
As soon as it began wearing off, we proceeded to smoke four big bowls out of my new glass spoon. After we finished having our smoke, CR was staring at me with a very scared look on his face. Then he said 'Evan, your face is changing!' 'You're turning into me!' I immediately began to calm him down saying it was only an effect of the drug we had taken and turned off the lights so while I was talking he wouldn't see my 'changing face'. Then when he said he was calm I turned the lights back on and was shocked, as I was looking at his face it began changing like he had described it. First his hair became curly and he looked just like CS then because I was thinking about CS, I thought of CS's girlfriend and immediately, CR's face turned into CS's girlfriend. CR said that I looked like I was turning into a Japanese man.
When I looked in my friends eyes, I saw spirals that made him look like a cartoon deception of a crazy person. When I thought of crazy, I thought of clowns and he proceeded to turn into one, then the Joker from Batman.
I thought of clowns and he proceeded to turn into one, then the Joker from Batman.
The weird thing is, is that when we were getting these insane visuals, everything else in my room looked normal. The last visual I remember was his face turning into the Kiss drummers face. Then the visuals ended. After that we discussed our 'trip' and went to sleep. This was definitely one of the most strange experiences I have ever had with a drug. It still amazes me how something so small can change my perception so much.
Peace, Love, and Unity.
